description: This is a Java source file that defines an Android IntentService called PingService. The service manages notification creation with action buttons for snoozing and dismissing notifications, handles different notification-related actions, and manages timing for notifications.

classes.name: PingService
classes.description: An Android IntentService responsible for creating and managing notifications with snooze and dismiss actions, handling notification intents, and timing notifications.

methods.name: PingService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IntentService with a specific name for background thread labeling.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents, determines the action (ping, snooze, dismiss), and triggers notification display or cancellation accordingly.

methods.name: issueNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification with snooze and dismiss actions, and sets up the intent for result activity.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Pauses execution for the specified duration (millis) to simulate a timer, then triggers a notification upon completion.
